google.title: The Völsung Clan (VSC) · Viking clan in Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord
google.description: VSC, The Völsung Clan: a Viking clan in Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord. Big events, Persistent Bannerlord and more. EU-based and newcomer friendly.

hero.alt: Painting of a Völsung shieldwall under the serpent banner in a snowy forest
hero.text: A community of Mount & Blade veterans who fight in Bannerlord's biggest events and open world mods.

about.title: Shieldwall, bowmen and riders
about.text: We are EU-based and newcomer friendly, offering training, guides and support in a welcoming atmosphere, backed by a strong and dedicated leadership team.

pillars.name: Persistent Bannerlord
pillars.text: One of the server's major factions. Daily player-led combat against other clans for resources, land and glory, fuelled by one of the strongest civilian divisions in the mod.
pillars.alt: The clan on the march across the desert

pillars.name: Weekly Events
pillars.text: Three main events every week with hundreds of other players. All optional, so you play on your own schedule.
pillars.alt: The Völsung shieldwall clashing with another faction on a forest hill

pillars.name: Training
pillars.text: Several sessions a month on settings, combat mechanics and groupfighting, plus dedicated sessions for archers and cavalry.

pillars.name: Fieldbattles
pillars.text: Native fieldbattles against other clans, 20v20 and 25v25, and internal skirmish nights with mixed teams in competitive style.
pillars.alt: A long Völsung shieldwall facing the enemy across a meadow

events.name: Middle-Earth
events.text: Lord of the Rings field battle with unique skins, weapons and maps.

events.name: Chronicles Drengr
events.text: 10th–11th century Europe with realistic damage, speed and armour.

events.name: BRE Sunday
events.text: Modded field battle, 500+ players, custom Völsung classes.

events.name: Promotion Ceremony
events.text: Last Sunday of the month, in our great hall.

media.title: A picture speaks a thousand words
media.gamesText: Community-led sessions you can jump into whenever you like.

questions.q: How do I join The Völsung Clan?
questions.a: Join our Discord, post a short application in #applications using the template, and leadership will help you through onboarding.

questions.q: Do I need Bannerlord multiplayer experience?
questions.a: No. We are a newcomer-friendly clan: trainings, guides and experienced players help you learn the shieldwall, the bow or a civilian role. Cavalry is the exception: a place among our riders is earned and reserved for the best.

questions.q: Where is the clan based and when do you play?
questions.a: We are an EU clan. Our weekly events run in the evening, Central European Time: Middle-Earth on Tuesday, Chronicles on Saturday and BRE on Sunday. Persistent Bannerlord runs every day.

questions.q: What do you play besides the events?
questions.a: Persistent Bannerlord, the open-world mod where we are one of the major factions, and community sessions of Crusader Kings, Counter-Strike, Total War, Wardogs, Valheim and more.

questions.q: How do ranks and promotions work?
questions.a: The first ranks are Thrall and Folk. After that you climb the Infantry, Archer or Civilian ladder of the Skjaldborg. Promotions are earned through both your skill and your activity in the clan. They are announced at the Promotion Ceremony on the last Sunday of every month, and it is fine if you cannot make it to the ceremony.

join.title: Think we might be right for you?
join.text: Don't worry if you're new to multiplayer or to Bannerlord. Trainings, guides and experienced players will help you build your skills.

steps.title: Join the Discord
steps.text: Open the invite and say hello.

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Post a short application in #applications using the template.

steps.title: Onboarding
steps.text: Questions go to #ask-for-help or to any member of leadership.

jarldom.text: The clan marches under one banner and is divided into Fylki, each with its own banner, Merkismaðr and page.

ranks.text: Every rank is earned in battle, in the civilian branch or by leading others.

hall.alt: Clansmen gathered in the Völsung great hall before the Jarl and his housecarls
hall.title: The great hall
hall.text: On the last Sunday of every month we gather in our great hall to celebrate the achievements of our clansmen and hear updates and announcements from our leadership.
